name: Broodmother
description: The last arrival, and the reason for every other body here. Two thirds of the drawing is an abdomen gone translucent with what is inside it — eggs scattered through the shell in the hive's own magenta, which is the only saturated colour on the cave's whole roster and is saved for this — and she carries one finished sac under the front, wrapped and grained. Short heavy legs: she does not chase, she arrives. The enraged state splits the shell and the clutch inside goes bright, so the second half of the fight is lit by what she is still laying. Gameplay radius 44.

enraged.description: Half down: the shell splits along the seams and the clutch inside lights the body — pale to dark, and the eggs from soft to full.

lay.description: the slowest gait in the roster, carrying the heaviest thing in it: the abdomen swings behind on its own beat and the sac under the front rocks against it, so the body reads as something being carried rather than worn
